What Shall I Wear?
история Speak & Smile · clothes · It's cold. Put on your coat!
тапни / стрелка →
It's cold and snowy!
Brrr! Look outside —
snow, snow, snow!
🦝 So cold!
Put on your winter clothes!
Hat, scarf, coat and boots —
cosy and warm!
🦝 Ready!
Now it's HOT!
The sun comes out —
too hot, too hot!
🦝 Phew! So hot!
Put on your summer clothes!
T-shirt, shorts and cap —
cool and comfy!
🦝 Much better!
Now it's RAINING!
Splish, splash —
up with the umbrella!
🦝 Oh no, rain!
I'll wear EVERYTHING!
Hat and shorts and one boot —
ha, ha, ha!
🦝 Silly me!
What a day!
A rainbow at last —
just right for me!
🦝🐶🐰 Hooray!
